name: BAS dbsim classified-fixture read
description: Lab classification rule for the Audspect dbsim simulation (DB-07). Fires when Filebeat extracted dbsim.marker AND dbsim.touches_classified, i.e. a marker-bearing audit or general-log record whose text mentions the classified fixture table customers_pii. Unlike the generic marker rule it fires only for statements touching that table, so its alert (not the generic one) is what a correct classification means. Matching is on keyword/boolean fields, not text analysis. A lab alert is a HINT, not proof of origin; the orchestrator's exact-match post-filter is the authority. UNVERIFIED until run on staging.
query: dbsim.marker : * and dbsim.touches_classified : true and not dbsim.is_meta : true and not dbsim.is_audit_lookup : true
author: Audspect
